name: cash.pools

list.description: List native BANK cash pool settings.

get.description: Query native BANK pool detail using an exact string pool id.

summary: BANK cash pool settings and native detail.
purpose: Inspect pool configuration, member configuration and native sweep rules without changing them.

fields.name: id
fields.meaning: Native list identity; native get requires an exact string id.

fields.name: mainCurrency
fields.meaning: Pool configuration currency; not the pool summary amount currency.

fields.name: cashPoolMemberVOS
fields.meaning: Native pool members and nested sweep configuration; original fields retained.

identity_description: Native id identifies each pool; string and integer identities remain distinct.
limitations: Fixed GUAPW3SG tenant and BANK category; pageSize=100 with zero-based rowStart offsets.
No native page echo; completeness requires stable total, arrival and unique identity agreement.
Native values, unknown fields, decimal precision and null/empty/zero distinctions are retained without historical whitelisting.
Settings meaning comes from native configuration fields; balance fields returned by the native object are retained without deriving values.
GET is POST JSON /cashPoolDetail.json with string id, tenant, inUse=Y and cashPoolCategory=BANK; data.id must echo the exact string.
Pool list/get are independent native inquiries; list rows never substitute for detail.
